title: WaterColor "Wanderlust in Watercolor" 55 Royal Fern Way
h1: WaterColor "Wanderlust in Watercolor" 55 Royal Fern Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per Watercolor Community guidelines the maximum number of wristbands this home is allotted is 12 bands to access Watercolor amenities and community pools- Located in the beautiful Forest community of WaterColor- Surrounded by natural green space and parks- Private pool and sitting spa *Pool heating is available October 1 through May 1st for an additional fee of $60 per day.- Community pools including Camp Watercolor- 4 adult bikes - Screened in porch- Parking for 2 vehicles- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and a third pool with zero-entry, as well as an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: When the sea and sun call, set course for Wanderlust in WaterColor. Tucked within the Forest neighborhood, this 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home accommodates 12 guests and includes access to the community pools, tennis courts, and WaterColor Beach Club. Guests will love gathering in the private backyard oasis and private pool.Infused with charm, this beautiful 2-story bungalow welcomes guests with a spacious front porch furnished with Adirondack and hanging basket chairs. Inside, honey-hued hardwood floors and pastel blue walls adorn the main-floor great room. A soft L-shaped sofa, loveseat, and armchair encircle a 65” Smart TV in the living space, while a dining table with 6 Parisian-style rattan chairs and a coffee bar sits opposite. The kitchen space in the back corner features high-end appliances, a 3-stool breakfast bar, and an open layout for seamless entertaining. Down the hall, the screened-in back porch encourages alfresco dining with a 6-seat table and offers the ultimate cozy reading nook with a round daybed. Surrounded by lush vegetation, the backyard retreat includes a pool, sitting area, outdoor shower, and outdoor kitchen. Spend sunny days splashing in the pool or reclining on the loungers. Beneath the pergola, overhead fans provide a delightful breeze as guests gather on the curved patio couch for evenings outdoors, or to watch TV. Adjacent is the outdoor kitchen and grill, with a picnic-style table for digging into barbecue. When bedtime arrives, retire to the primary bedroom with a king bed or the guest bedroom with a queen bed, each boasting screen porch access and a Smart TV on this level. For extended trips, the hall closet has a convenient stacked washer and dryer.Additional sleeping accommodations are on the second level, including a guest bedroom with a king bed and a bunk room with 2 full-over-full beds.Excellent community and private amenities make Wanderlust in WaterColor a dream setting for a relaxing vacation. There’s parking for 2 vehicles or hop on the 4 complimentary adult bikes for some laid-back exploration. The nearest beach access is Hickory Beach Access, a 15-minute walk away. Book this beach bungalow today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 12):FIRST FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: 2 Full-over-Full Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*The outdoor fireplace is not for guest use.
